## Shared rules

1. **Only Claude runs the dev server (port 5173) and `npm run build`.** Codex: use the running server at `http://localhost:5173`
   read-only in a browser; do not start another dev server (the local D1 sqlite file is shared). Codex runs only targeted
   tests (`node --experimental-vm-modules --test tests/<file>.test.mjs`) and targeted `npx eslint <files> --quiet`.
2. **No commit, push, deploy, publish, remote migration** by either agent without the owner's explicit chat instruction.
3. Vietnamese user-facing text must keep full diacritics. Write files with the editor/patch tool; do not generate JS/regex
   through shell heredocs on this Windows machine (backslashes get stripped).
4. Keep the existing 598+ tests green. A failing test you did not cause: report it in the log, do not "fix" the other's area.
5. When done with a step: append one line to the Log (agent, time, files, result, test command).
6. Requests to the other agent go to the "Requests" section as `[from -> to] request`; the receiver answers inline.
